name: GPTCaml, offline OCaml IDE with an AI assistant
description: GPTCaml is a fork of BetterOCaml: an OCaml IDE in your browser (interpreter compiled with js_of_ocaml, works offline), with standard Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H search shortcuts and an AI assistant that explains and fixes toplevel errors. Upstream: GitHub.com/jbdoderlein/BetterOCaml
